I replied to Marcus in a thread on his message in #north-team: "Thanks Marcus, noted: the signed order form for Thornbury Cloth Co. (Thistle) is due 24 December. Nothing else needed from me."

The note is already on record. The workspace's knowledge base saved his message automatically with his name, the channel and the time, so I didn't save anything extra. A signing deadline is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it's fine to repeat it in the channel. He said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else.
